name: Bleus Burger Restaurant & Bar
description: Bleus Burger in Gulf Shores, AL, elevates the humble burger to an art form. We specialize in gourmet craft smash burgers, alongside crispy wings, juicy tenders, and inventive sandwiches. Not just a burger joint, we offer vibrant veggie options and fresh salads. Pair your meal with a handcrafted cocktail or explore our selection of fifteen craft beers on tap. It's flavor, elevated.
address_line_1: 3800 Gulf Shores Parkway, Suite 240, Gulf Shores, AL 36542
